page.title: Everything you've built so far.
page.description: Your record of academics, leadership, research and execution. This is Oryn's development assessment — not an admissions score, and not visible to universities.

professionalProfile.title: Professional profile
professionalProfile.description: What other Oryn students see on your public profile.

featured.title: Featured
featured.description: Pin your best 3-5 items to the top of your public profile.

strength.title: Profile Strength
strength.description: How much Oryn knows about you — separate from how strong your profile is. Only you can see this.
strength.fullyFilled: Your profile is fully filled out.

journeyNote.emptyTitle: Add a few things and this page starts working.
journeyNote.emptyBody: Oryn hasn't been given enough to assess any area yet. That's a gap in the record, not a judgement about you — add your courses, activities and projects below and it will start telling you where you actually stand.
journeyNote.gapTitle: {dimension} is where your next effort counts most.
journeyNote.gapBodyWithAwaiting: Of the {assessed, plural, one {# area} other {# areas}} Oryn can currently assess, this one has the least behind it — so the same hours move your profile furthest here. {awaitingEvidence, plural, one {# other area has} other {# other areas have}} nothing recorded yet, so this reading may change as you add more.
journeyNote.gapBodySimple: Of everything Oryn can assess, this area has the least behind it — which makes it where the same hours move your profile furthest.
journeyNote.strengthBody: It's the best-evidenced part of your record. Adding more of the same is unlikely to change how your profile reads — the leverage is elsewhere.

journey.title: Your journey
journey.description: Everything on one timeline, newest first. The Academics / Experience / Recognition / Skills tabs above are where you add and edit — this is how it reads.

coursework.title: Coursework
coursework.description: AP, IB HL/SL, A-Level, honors, and regular courses. Oryn uses these to understand your academic rigor and subject range.
coursework.empty: No coursework yet. Add the courses you're taking — advanced coursework is one of the strongest academic signals.

testScores.title: Test scores
testScores.description: SAT, ACT, AP, IB, language proficiency, and more.

activities.title: Activities
activities.description: Clubs, leadership roles, sports, summer programs.
activities.empty: No activities yet. Add clubs, leadership, or other experiences.

sports.title: Sports
sports.description: Athletic history — a first-class part of your profile, not folded into Activities.
sports.empty: No sports yet. Add a team, club, or individual sport you take seriously.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Things you've built or shipped, on your own or with a team.

research.title: Research
research.empty: No research experience yet — publication isn't required for a strong score.

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: What you're working toward — recommendations trace back to these.
goals.empty: No goals yet. What are you working toward?

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Up to 15. Self-declared — connections can endorse a skill once they're added below.
skills.empty: No skills yet. Add up to 15 — technical, creative, analytical, or otherwise.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Levels use CEFR, the scale most universities state their requirements in. Add language certificates under Certifications.
languages.empty: No languages yet. Add the ones you speak, including your first language.

cv.title: CV Generator
cv.description: Built entirely from your structured profile — choose what to include, then print or save as PDF. Nothing is invented; polish wording for any entry from the Profile page's "Improve with AI" first.

cvImport.title: Scan a CV.
cvImport.description: Already have your record written down somewhere? Oryn can read it and pull out your education, activities, awards, projects, research and work — you review everything before any of it is saved.
cvImport.notConfiguredDescription: This needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to be set — see API_SETUP.md. You can still add everything to your profile manually.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: Everything you've done, in one place.

researchIdeas.title: Find a project you can actually finish.
researchIdeas.description: Oryn proposes research scaled to your level and the time you have — grounded in real academic literature and public data, never an impressive-sounding question with no way to answer it.
researchIdeas.fieldLabel: What field do you want to work in?
researchIdeas.noIdeasDescription: Name a field and Oryn will propose three projects scaled to your level — each one something you could realistically finish, with real data sources rather than an impressive-sounding title.
researchIdeas.couldntGenerate: Oryn couldn't put together a project for that field. Try naming it a little differently.

storyBank.title: Essay Story Bank
storyBank.description: Find which of your real experiences carry an essay-worthy story, and how you might structure it. Oryn organizes what you've recorded — it never invents an event and never writes the essay for you.
storyBank.emptyTitle: Add experiences to your profile first
storyBank.emptyDescription: Add activities, projects, research, sports, volunteering, or work to your profile first — your essay stories come from things you've actually done, never from something invented for you.
storyBank.promptPlaceholder: Paste the exact prompt, e.g. "Discuss an accomplishment, event, or realization that sparked a period of personal growth."
storyBank.helperText: Leave everything unchecked to consider all of them. Entries with story notes give far better results — add yours from the Profile page.
storyBank.missingDetailPrefix: Worth adding to your story notes: {detail}
storyBank.footerDisclaimer: These are structures for your own writing, not a draft. Oryn never writes the essay for you — and never adds a detail you didn't record yourself.

featuredManager.emptyState: Nothing featured yet. Pin your best project, award, or research to the top of your profile.
featuredManager.maxFeatured: You've featured the maximum of {max} items.
featuredManager.noneYet: You don't have any of these yet — add one to your profile first.
featuredManager.genericError: Couldn't feature that. Please try again.

progress.title: Progress
progress.subtitle: How your profile has changed over the last {days} days.
progress.developing: {count, plural, one {# area is} other {# areas are}} developing.
progress.awaitingEvidence: Oryn still has too little to say about {count} of them.
progress.nextToStrengthenBody: — {state}. Of everything Oryn has a read on, this is where the same hours of work change your profile most.
progress.notEnoughHistoryDescription: Check back after your profile has had a chance to change over a few weeks. Oryn compares your dimensions against a snapshot taken at least a month ago.
progress.movedForward: {count, plural, one {# area moved forward} other {# areas moved forward}}
progress.projectsCompleted: Projects marked complete in the last {days} days
progress.applicationsSubmitted: Applications submitted or updated in the last {days} days

recommendations.title: Recommendations
recommendations.writePlaceholder: What would you tell someone about working with them?
recommendations.deleteDialogDescription: This removes the recommendation you wrote — it can't be undone.
